hooks.name: Deny dialers (shell)
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that could send an SMS, voice call or push to a real person (Twilio, Africa's Talking, SNS publish, Connect, SES/Pinpoint sends). Sending to humans is a human step.

action.command: in=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.. | .command? // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] || c="$in"; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eiq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(twilio|africastalking)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|api\.(twilio|africastalking)\.com|aws +(sns +publish|connect|pinpoint|ses +send|sesv2 +send)'; then echo 'deny-dialers: this command could message or call a real person. Sending is a human step; run it yourself in test mode if needed.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
